posts.meta_description:
2,741 likes, 37 comments - thefoodranger on September 11, 2026: "Trying the most Viral seafood restaurant in Greece, Atlantikos! This place is the number one most reviewed place in Athens for seafood, found just a short walk from Monastiraki. Every time I walk by this place in Athens, there is a massive lineup down the street, so we decided to try it. Was it any good?
 
I would say yes, it’s incredible, but I found it to be quite too famous, it’s mostly tourists so if you want to get a table without a long wait you should go early. I would come back but I think I will explore more and more places in Athens first, but yes overall an amazing place I loved their Mussels saganaki, their anchovies in the oven with garlic , their grilled fish, their fava spread, and their seafood pasta! Amazing place to eat in Athens! I could go back just for their seafood pasta and mussels! And all their dishes!".

posts.meta_description:
5,071 likes, 89 comments - thefoodranger on September 5, 2026: "The oldest taverna in Athens? This shop is called Diporto and is a classic spot to visit to eat authentic Greek home style cooking, drink wine from the barrel, and feel like you’re stepping back in time.

It’s a short walk from Monastiraki area and is worth the walk over, just make sure you find it! It’s underground and you should follow Diporto on Google Maps, and you will have a nice hearty lunch! 

Contrary to popular opinion, Anthony Bourdain did not actually eat here but I think he would have loved this place, it’s a true not so hidden anymore gem but it’s popular for good reason, you get honest and delicious home cooked Greek food. I would definitely come back to this place and I usually do whenever I visit Athens! Diporto, come here for a nice lunch! And follow for more great food finds around Europe!".

posts.meta_description:
11K likes, 133 comments - thefoodranger on September 1, 2026: "Trying apparently the best seafood restaurant in Athens @polpoathens . To be honest, this was a life changing meal! I will be coming back here again and again whenever I visit Athens, it was that good! 

Highlights included the fresh grilled red prawns literally right out of the ocean. A red shrimp ceviche with lemon, olive oil, salt, bell pepper. An incredible fisherman’s linguine. Fresh carpaccio, pickled octopus, and a star dish, tomatoes from the island of Crete which were the most flavorful tomatoes I’ve ever eaten! 

I already can’t wait to come back again! It’s a little outside the main downtown area, but so worth coming here, just a quick 15-20 minute taxi from downtown, and you’re in seafood heaven!".

posts.meta_description:
128K likes, 960 comments - thefoodranger on August 30, 2026: "Best Greek yogurt in the world? We’re in Athens trying the famous Stani yogurt shop. They are famous for their strained sheeps milk yogurt with walnuts and honey. Honestly this was the best yogurt I’ve ever eaten!

It was so smooth and creamy and topped with local honey and walnuts, you don’t want to come to Athens without trying this! They are also famous for their Greek lukumades donuts with honey and cinnamon, their butter with honey, and their cream with cinnamon! 

Honestly, I fell in love with all of them! It’s like a dairy heaven here! This shop has been open for nearly 100 years and if you’re coming to Greece, come try this place even if you’re just in Athens for a day before going to a Greek island, it’s worth it!".

posts.meta_description: 37K likes, 641 comments - thefoodranger on August 28, 2026: "Trying the most Viral kebab shop in Athens @kiraristos ! This place has been showing up on my feed and I flew into Athens just to try it!!I gotta say it was totally worth the hype! The kebabs were so juicy and they make a signature bread bowl packed with kebabs, tomato, and yogurt. Not only that they also make delicious gyros and souvlaki! I would highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Athens! I will be back whenever I’m craving some delicious kebabs, wow they were so juicy! Where should we try next in Athens?".
